q: What if I know my business problem but not what technology I need?
a: That's the most common starting point — and the best one. Describe what's slowing you down or what you want to achieve. I'll suggest the simplest solution that would work, which is sometimes smaller than you expect.

q: Can you integrate AI into our existing systems?
a: Usually, yes. If your systems offer an API, an export or database access, AI can often be connected to them — for example to read incoming requests, search your documents or draft replies. I check what your current tools allow before recommending anything.

q: Can you improve an existing product instead of building from scratch?
a: Yes. Adding features, integrating new tools or modernising part of an existing website or app is often faster and cheaper than a rebuild. I review what you have first and tell you honestly which option makes sense.

q: Do you build both websites and mobile apps?
a: Yes — websites, online stores, web applications, and iOS and Android apps. When a project needs more than one, they can share the same backend so everything stays in sync.

q: Can you connect our CRM, Shopify store or internal systems?
a: In most cases. Connecting tools through their APIs, webhooks or automation platforms is a core part of what I do. Some systems are more open than others, so I confirm what's possible early on.

q: How much does a custom solution cost?
a: It depends on scope, so I don't publish fixed prices. After a short conversation about what you need, you get a clear estimate before any work starts. Starting with a smaller first phase is often a good way to prove the value.

q: How long does a project take?
a: Focused work — a single automation or a landing page — is usually measured in weeks. Larger platforms and apps take longer. You get a realistic timeline together with the estimate.

q: Can you work with our existing team?
a: Yes. I can work alongside your developers, designers or operations team, taking on a defined part of the project or the parts that need a specific skill.

q: Do you provide support after launch?
a: Yes. Support, fixes and improvements after launch can be arranged around what your solution needs. Many projects continue with small improvements once real usage shows what matters most.
